metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code present (Python 3.12 Lambda handlers) with deployable entry points, dependency manifest (pyproject.toml), and IaC provisioning AWS resources (SAM template defining Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway). Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: DynamoDB persistent data store with write endpoints (create charge, refund). All API operations mutate state. No outbound service calls, no message queue consumers, no multi-service orchestration. Classified as stateful-crud.

top_gaps.title: Deployment Strategy
top_gaps.gap: Manual direct-to-production deployment with no staged rollout
top_gaps.impact: High risk of production incidents from untested deployments; no canary or traffic shifting

top_gaps.title: Resource Tagging Governance
top_gaps.gap: No resource tags on any AWS resources
top_gaps.impact: Cannot track costs, identify ownership, or enforce budget controls

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: CI pipeline lacks automated deployment stage
top_gaps.impact: Manual deployment bottleneck; human error risk on every release

top_gaps.title: Application Security Pipeline
top_gaps.gap: No SAST tool in pipeline; Dependabot only
top_gaps.impact: Vulnerabilities in application code may reach production undetected

top_gaps.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
top_gaps.gap: Static threshold alarms only; no anomaly detection
top_gaps.impact: Gradual degradation and novel failure modes go unnoticed

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — No dedicated orchestration service
findings.description: The service operations are atomic DynamoDB transactions with a structured idempotency pattern. No multi-step business workflows requiring orchestration exist. No Step Functions or equivalent deployed.
findings.gap: No dedicated workflow orchestration service deployed. Future expansion to multi-step payment workflows would benefit from Step Functions.
findings.recommendation: If payment flows expand to include external provider calls or multi-step settlement, adopt AWS Step Functions for orchestration.

findings.title: Async Messaging — No event emission for state changes
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No messaging or streaming infrastructure deployed. The service lacks event emission for domain events (charge.created, refund.processed).
findings.gap: No event emission mechanism for state changes. Downstream consumers must poll the API rather than subscribing to events.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge event emission on charge/refund state changes. Enable DynamoDB Streams as alternative event source for change data capture.

findings.title: Network Security — No VPC endpoints for defense-in-depth
findings.description: Serverless architecture uses IAM-based security model. Lambda accesses DynamoDB via AWS service endpoints with least-privilege IAM roles. No VPC configuration or VPC endpoints.
findings.gap: No VPC endpoints configured for DynamoDB access. Traffic traverses AWS internal networking without explicit private path enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding VPC configuration with DynamoDB VPC endpoint if regulatory requirements demand private network paths.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — No cross-region replication or restore testing
findings.description: DynamoDB table has Point-in-Time Recovery enabled with 35-day retention. SSE encryption enabled.
findings.gap: No cross-region backup replication. No documented restore procedure or restore testing.
findings.recommendation: Add cross-region DynamoDB table replica or AWS Backup plan with cross-region copy. Document and periodically test PITR restore procedures.

findings.title: IaC Coverage — Operational resources not codified
findings.description: SAM template defines all primary infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, IAM). Operational resources (CloudWatch dashboard, alarms) referenced in RUNBOOK are not defined in IaC.
findings.gap: CloudWatch dashboards and alarms are manually created. Estimated IaC coverage: ~80%.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms and dashboard definitions to the SAM template or a monitoring nested stack.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — No automated deployment
findings.description: GitHub Actions pipeline automates lint, type-check, OpenAPI validation, and tests. Deployment is entirely manual: sam build && sam deploy --config-env prod.
findings.gap: No automated deployment stage in CI/CD. Manual deployment creates bottlenecks and human error risk.
findings.recommendation: Add a deploy job to GitHub Actions triggered on main branch merge. Use sam deploy with OIDC authentication. Add staging environment for pre-production validation.

findings.title: Async vs Sync — No async patterns for state propagation
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No event emission, no message publishing. The service receives API calls and writes to DynamoDB with no mechanism to notify downstream consumers.
findings.gap: No mechanism to notify downstream consumers of state changes asynchronously. Consumers must poll for charge/refund status.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge event publishing for charge.created and refund.processed domain events to enable decoupled downstream integration.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — AWS-managed keys only
findings.description: DynamoDB table has SSE enabled using AWS-managed keys (default). All data at rest is encrypted.
findings.gap: Uses AWS-managed encryption keys rather than customer-managed KMS keys. No explicit key rotation policy.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table to enable key rotation control and centralized key audit.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — No vulnerability scanning tool
findings.description: Lambda managed runtime eliminates OS patching. Dependabot configured for weekly dependency updates.
findings.gap: No explicit vulnerability scanning tool (Inspector, Snyk, pip-audit) for deep transitive dependency scanning.
findings.recommendation: Add pip-audit or safety to CI pipeline. Consider AWS Inspector for Lambda function scanning.

findings.title: Security Pipeline — No SAST tool configured
findings.description: Dependabot configured for dependency updates. CI has ruff (linter) and mypy (type-checker) but no security-focused SAST tool.
findings.gap: No SAST tool in CI/CD pipeline. No security gate blocking merges on critical findings.
findings.recommendation: Add Bandit (Python SAST) or Semgrep to CI pipeline. Configure security gate blocking on high/critical findings.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — No formal SLOs defined
findings.description: Threshold-based alarms exist for 5xx rate, idempotency conflicts, and DDB throttles. CloudWatch dashboard monitors latency and errors.
findings.gap: No formal SLO definitions with error budgets. Alarms imply service levels but are not structured as measurable SLOs.
findings.recommendation: Define formal SLOs (p99 latency < 500ms for 99.9%, error rate < 0.1%) with error budget tracking.

findings.title: Business Metrics — Partial coverage
findings.description: ChargeCreated metric published via aws-lambda-powertools. Structured logging includes business context.
findings.gap: Not all operations emit business metrics — refund_charge handler does not publish a metric.
findings.recommendation: Add RefundCreated metric to refund handler. Add metrics for charge amount, refund reasons, and idempotency hit rate.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection — Static thresholds only
findings.description: Static threshold alarms documented: 5xx > 1%, conflicts > 10/min, DDB throttle = any.
findings.gap: No anomaly detection. Static thresholds miss gradual degradation and novel failure patterns.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudWatch anomaly detection on p99 latency and error rate. Add composite alarms combining multiple signals.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — Direct-to-production with no staged rollout
findings.description: Manual sam deploy directly to production. No canary, blue/green, or traffic shifting. Rollback requires manual redeployment of previous artifact.
findings.gap: All deployments go live immediately with no staged rollout. Bad deployments affect 100% of traffic instantly. No automated rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add AutoPublishAlias and DeploymentPreference (Canary10Percent5Minutes) with alarm-gated promotion to Lambda functions in SAM template.

findings.title: Integration Testing — Partial workflow coverage
findings.description: Contract/behavioral tests cover idempotent charge creation, conflict detection, and scope enforcement. Tests run in CI via pytest.
findings.gap: Only create_charge path tested. refund_charge and getCharge not explicitly tested. No end-to-end integration test against deployed infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Add test coverage for refund and retrieval paths. Add post-deployment smoke test against deployed API Gateway.

findings.title: Incident Response — Runbook not automated
findings.description: Structured RUNBOOK.md with dashboards, alarms, procedures, and escalation path. Well-organized for human consumption.
findings.gap: Runbook is markdown only — not machine-readable or automated. No self-healing automation.
findings.recommendation: Convert high-frequency procedures into SSM Automation documents. Add automated rollback on alarm trigger via SAM DeploymentPreference.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — No CODEOWNERS or formal attribution
findings.description: Clear service ownership signals: dashboard, named alarms, escalation to Payments Platform team. POWERTOOLS_SERVICE_NAME set.
findings.gap: No CODEOWNERS file. No per-alarm owner tags. Ownership documented in RUNBOOK but not enforced via tooling.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS file. Add owner tags to CloudWatch resources when codified in IaC.

findings.title: Resource Tagging — No tags on any resources
findings.description: No resource tags defined in SAM template. DynamoDB table, Lambda functions, and API Gateway have no Tags property.
findings.gap: No cost allocation, ownership, or environment tags. Cannot track costs or identify ownership.
findings.recommendation: Add Tags to Globals in SAM template: service, team, environment, cost-center.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on Lambda (managed serverless). No EC2.

evaluations.title: Managed Databases
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB fully managed with automatic multi-AZ, PITR, SSE.

evaluations.title: API Entry Point
evaluations.reason: API Gateway with OAuth2 authorizer, OpenAPI validation, X-Ray tracing.

evaluations.title: Auto-Scaling
evaluations.reason: Lambda inherent scaling + DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST. No static provisioning.

evaluations.title: High Availability and Fault Isolation
evaluations.reason: All managed services (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway) inherently multi-AZ.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Python 3.12 with boto3 >=1.34 and aws-lambda-powertools >=2.30. All axes current.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Independent microservice with own data store, clear API contract, single responsibility.

evaluations.title: Long-Running Process Handling
evaluations.reason: All operations complete in milliseconds. No operations approach 30 seconds.

evaluations.title: API Versioning Strategy
evaluations.reason: URL path versioning /v1/ with semantic spec version 1.4.0. Contract-first CI validation.

evaluations.title: Service Discovery
evaluations.reason: API Gateway provides stable entry. No hard-coded endpoints. All references via env vars/SAM refs.

evaluations.title: Unstructured Data Storage
evaluations.reason: Service handles structured transaction data only. No unstructured data needs.

evaluations.title: Unified Data Access Layer
evaluations.reason: Centralized data access via app.py (_table, _idempotent_put). Handlers never access DB directly.

evaluations.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB is serverless with no engine versioning. AWS manages upgrades transparently.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: No stored procedures or proprietary SQL. All logic in Python application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only. CloudTrail is an account-level service not evaluated per-application.

evaluations.title: API Authentication
evaluations.reason: All endpoints authenticated via OAuth2 client-credentials with Lambda authorizer and scope enforcement.

evaluations.title: Centralized Identity Integration
evaluations.reason: AWS Cognito as centralized IdP. OAuth2 client-credentials flow. No standalone auth.

evaluations.title: Secrets Management
evaluations.reason: No secrets in codebase. IAM roles for AWS service auth. No hardcoded credentials.

evaluations.title: Distributed Tracing
evaluations.reason: X-Ray active on all functions and API Gateway. Powertools Tracer. Correlation ID propagated.
